name: fly-machine
title: Fly: Machine
primer: This is an exercise for chest strengthening.
steps: Adjust the machine so the pads are at chest height when you sit.
Sit on the machine with your back flat.
Place your forearms on the pads, parallel to the floor. This is the starting position.
Using your forearms, push the pads together slowly as you squeeze your chest.
Return your arms to the stretched out starting position in a controlled motion.
